title: Experiment
description: Per-experiment record for the from-scratch bold regime. The `classification` enum IS the vocabulary table in program.md — if one changes, the other must change in the same commit. Gate objects: novelty_audit (P8, required before Stage-1), p9 + p10 (required for any classification above Hold), p11 (required for Winner or Fragile), stage1_curve (P12, required for every Kill).

ci95.description: [low, high] of the bootstrap 95% CI on the seed-averaged per-unit diff.

wilcoxon_p.description: null only when scipy was unavailable (bootstrap CI stands alone).

per_seed_means.description: Mean per-unit delta per seed (favorable = positive), from paired_unit_test. REQUIRED on vs_baseline for Winner track: every working seed must be favorable — this is the exit criterion's multi-seed clause.

verdict.description: pass = CI excludes 0 favorably AND wilcoxon_p < 0.05.

source_domain.description: Non-CV/ML source domain, e.g. 'wireless_comms', 'optimal_transport'. exp000 (baseline) uses 'none'.

kind.description: Matches adapter.inject_mechanism's spec kinds; 'baseline' is exp000 only.

family.description: Coarse mechanism class, e.g. 'predictive-correction', 'lateral-inhibition'. The class key P2 uses to track class-site saturation — keep it stable across experiments of the same class.

site.description: A name from adapter.sites() for site_wrap; null for aux_objective/topology/baseline.

params_count.description: Params ADDED over the baseline (the P9 budget number).

cites_baseline_finding_ids.description: REQUIRED when phase == phase-1. Each id must exist in trajectory/profiles/baseline.json under analysis.candidate_failure_modes. Forces every proposal to be grounded in a baseline diagnostic finding rather than picked from an imagined menu.

produces_artifact.description: For phase-0 experiments: the artifact written, e.g. 'profiles/baseline.json', 'profiles/calibration.json'.

novelty_audit.description: P8 — REQUIRED before Stage-1 for every phase-1 mechanism. Must be mechanistic (what computation differs), never adjectives.

nearest_cv_analog.description: The closest existing CV block, named (e.g. 'SE block', 'BiFPN').

structural_difference.description: What is structurally different from that analog.

mechanism_of_difference.description: Why that difference should change what is LEARNED — the causal story, stated so it can be checked blind later.

metrics_per_stage_per_seed.description: Keyed by stage, then by seed (as string), then metric dict.

stage1_curve.description: P12 — REQUIRED for every Stage-1 Kill: the full per-epoch primary-metric trajectory (from the training-time val subset), keyed by seed as string.

p9.description: Matched-control attribution numbers. REQUIRED for any classification above Hold. Deltas are seed-averaged primary metric, sign-normalized (positive = favorable).

control_run_ids.description: Run dirs / ids of the param_matched_generic control runs.

mech_minus_control.description: The form-specific effect — the number the paper claim rests on.

p10.description: Per-unit statistics. vs_baseline and vs_control REQUIRED for any classification above Hold. control_vs_baseline is the capacity-effect ledger: in the from-scratch regime a param-matched control legitimately helps (Axiom 2), so this test MEASURES the generic-capacity effect P9 subtracts — control-beats-baseline is expected, not a malfunction. Log it whenever control data exists; its running magnitude vs the noise floor is the audit.

p11.description: Sealed-seed replication. REQUIRED for Winner or Fragile.

per_seed_deltas.description: Keyed by confirmation seed (as string): primary-metric delta vs baseline, sign-normalized.

control_replicated.description: True if the control was re-run on the confirmation seeds (required when the P9 margin was under CONTROL_REPLICATION_NOISE_MULTIPLE x the S2 noise floor).

classification.description: MUST match the vocabulary table in program.md verbatim.

subtype.description: First seven are scientific (Kill/Reject/Hold/Fragile/Winner); last five are operational (Op-Fail).

provenance.description: Pins exactly what ran. git makes code tamper-evident; the manifest sha does the same for the dataset.

git_commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD at run time.

data_manifest_sha256.description: sha256 of coco2k_manifest.json (written once by setup/create_coco2k.py).

train_args_hash.description: Optional: hash of the resolved ultralytics train args (runs_v5/<name>/args.yaml).

ultralytics_commit.description: git rev-parse of ultralytics_src (the framework is an EDITABLE install, outside this repo's own commit — record it or framework drift is invisible).

retry_of.description: P4 targeted retry only: the original experiment this corrects. At most one experiment may ever cite a given id here (hard cap: one retry per original).

retry_reason.description: P4: the single diagnosable design flaw and the correction applied, with the predicted direction of change. Required when retry_of is set.

items.description: Insight ids written to insights.md as a result of this experiment.
